Base arm uncomputable — attribution recall 0.5% (1000 stories, 4361 quotes, only 21 label-attributed -> 2 usable pairs; base raw-prose voices characters via pronouns/untagged dialogue, not 'LABEL said' tags). Instruct arm UNDER-POWERED — per-persona n=118-161, held-out R2 negative (-0.12 to -0.29) in a 3584-dim ridge (structural at n<<p); beats shuffle-pairing null but not the mean. Not clean evidence of absence. GCP instance torn down (billing stopped). Real fix (0-GPU on already-uploaded stories, needs a code change + judge re-attribution): (1) per-DIALOGUE-LINE targets (each turn=a point) to lift n into the thousands; (2) Sonnet label-binary re-attribution (--reattribute-batch) to rescue base recall. Both required together; base re-attribution alone stays under-powered. Awaiting user go on the per-line re-fit.

Same 4-persona panel (Wren/HELIOS/Dana/Vex). SCENE-grouped folds. Scope caveat carried: labeled-script is a turn-structured (chat-adjacent) regime, distinct from #931 free-prose fiction. Rebuilding pipeline; new generation (~2-3 GPU-h) after smoke.
